lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arranged in approximately four vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The columns contain between 3 and 5 high-luminance centroids each, forming a staggered grid across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, particularly visible in the mid-flank region where the blobs are centered within these vertical luminance corridors.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is visible in the upper third of the frame, showing a clear linear trajectory with a high-contrast luminance gradient (highlight on the superior edge, shadow on the inferior edge).

other_distinctive_markers: A unique U-shaped or parabolic curvilinear band of elevated pixel intensity is present on the mid-lateral flank, encircling a single high-luminance centroid.
